name: ldap-contacts
title: LDAP Contacts
description: Lookup names and telephone numbers within an LDAP (AD) directory
author: frdmn

commands.name: ldap-lookup
commands.title: LDAP Lookup
commands.description: Search for people by name or phone number in your LDAP directory

preferences.name: ldapSecurity
preferences.title: Security
preferences.description: How to connect to the directory server

preferences.name: ldapPort
preferences.title: LDAP Port
preferences.description: Port of your LDAP/AD server. Leave empty to use 389, or 636 for LDAPS

preferences.name: ldapUsername
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: Bind DN or user principal name (e.g. ldap@company.ads)

preferences.name: ldapSearchBase
preferences.title: Search Base
preferences.description: Distinguished name to search within (e.g. OU=Frankfurt,DC=Company,DC=Ads)

preferences.name: ldapTLSVerify
preferences.title: Verify TLS Certificate
preferences.description: Validate the server certificate against the system trust store and CA file below. Disable only for self-signed setups without a CA.
preferences.label: Verify TLS Certificate

preferences.name: ldapCACert
preferences.title: TLS CA Certificate
preferences.description: Path to a PEM file with the CA that signed your server certificate (for internal CAs)

preferences.name: phonePrefix
preferences.title: Phone Prefix
preferences.description: Internal extension prefix stripped from results (e.g. 970)
